summary: Spec fidelity (checker.md section 5/6: 'The checker drives done, failed and timeout outcomes'; section 2: 'a tool cannot pass by withholding fixtures'): fixture.rs:567 accepts an async.outcomes list of any non-empty subset, and plan_async drives only those. Probe on the conforming fake with outcomes ["done"]: L2.async is pass, exit 0; the failed and timeout conditions (failed exits 1 with a registered code, timeout exits 1 retryable with the same wait in next[0]) are never exercised and nothing says so. A tool whose test build cannot hang or fail passes the MUST row by listing the outcome it supports. A missing outcome should leave L2.async unprovided naming commands.<id>.async.outcomes. Blast radius: L2.async for every async tool; atip.checkl2safety.10 and .12 use the full list.
